title: Design, synthesis and evaluation of anticancer activity of new pyrazoline derivatives by down-regulation of VEGF: Molecular docking and apoptosis inducing activity.
authors: Hassan, Rasha A; Emam, Soha H; Hwang, Dukhyun; Kim, Gun-Do; Hassanin, Soha O; Khalil, Mona G; Abdou, Amr M; Sonousi, Amr
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成吡唑啉衍生物作为抗癌剂，通过分子对接研究其与VEGFR-2和STAT3结合，但核心是药物小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Two series of pyrazoline compounds were designed and synthesized as antiproliferative agents by VEGFR pathway inhibition. All synthesized compounds were screened by the National Cancer Institute (NCI), Bethesda, USA for anticancer activity against 60 human cancer cell lines. Compound 3f exhibited the highest anticancer activity on the ovarian cell line (OVCAR-4) with IC(50) = 0.29 muM and on the breast cell line (MDA-MB-468) with IC(50) = 0.35 muM. It also exhibited the highest selectivity index (SI = 74). Compound 3f caused cell cycle arrest in OVCAR-4 cell line at the S phase which consequently inhibited cell proliferation and induced apoptosis. Moreover, 3f showed potent down-regulation of VEGF and p-VEGFR-2. Docking studies showed that compound 3f interacts in a similar pattern to axitinib on the VEGFR-2 receptor. The same compound was also able to fit into the gorge of STAT3 binding site, the transcription factor for VEGF, which explains the VEGF down-regulation.
abstract_zh: 设计并合成了两个系列的吡唑啉化合物，作为通过VEGFR通路抑制的抗增殖剂。所有合成的化合物均经美国国立癌症研究所（NCI，贝塞斯达）筛选，针对60种人类癌细胞系进行抗癌活性测试。化合物3f在卵巢癌细胞系（OVCAR-4）上表现出最高的抗癌活性，IC(50) = 0.29 μM，在乳腺癌细胞系（MDA-MB-468）上IC(50) = 0.35 μM。它还表现出最高的选择性指数（SI = 74）。化合物3f在OVCAR-4细胞系中引起S期细胞周期阻滞，从而抑制细胞增殖并诱导凋亡。此外，3f显示出对VEGF和p-VEGFR-2的强效下调作用。对接研究表明，化合物3f与阿昔替尼在VEGFR-2受体上的相互作用模式相似。同一化合物还能适配STAT3结合位点的峡谷，该位点是VEGF的转录因子，这解释了VEGF的下调机制。
